featured_reviews.name: Brinda Parekh
featured_reviews.review_text:
A space built with love, legacy, and a whole lot of passion! A place where you’ll discover a curated blend of trendy and classic men’s fashion. Whether you’re picking out something for a wedding, a festive celebration, or just want to look sharp for a casual day out, there’s something here for every moment. YES, they even offer customised options to get that perfect fit!

And then there’s Yash - warm, honest, and genuinely helpful. He helps you find something that truly suits you. Shopping here feels more like catching up with a friend who just happens to have great taste!

featured_reviews.name: Aashima Mahajan
featured_reviews.review_text:
Amazing variety and prices!
All sizes from small to 5XL are available here. They customise too, choose your fabrics and styling and get made whatever you want.
Super bright guy Yash, owner of the shop, will help you choose the best combinations for your skin tone, height and body type.
One GO TO SHOP for all things MEN.

featured_reviews.name: Taufiq Khan
featured_reviews.review_text: Dios Damroos offers an amazing collection of shirts and more for every occasion—festive, work, or casual—all under one roof. I’ve shopped for almost every occasion, and the fit, comfort, and fabric durability are outstanding. Their offline store is a must-visit, with a great selection, top-notch quality, and excellent service. Highly recommended!

featured_reviews.name: Shalin Solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
I can't recommend Dios Damroos enough! As a longtime friend of Yash, I've had the pleasure of witnessing the incredible growth of this fashion outlet, and I can honestly say it never disappoints. The collection is wide, diverse, and always on-trend, ensuring there's something for everyone, whether you're looking for something casual or a bit more sophisticated.

What really stands out, though, is the exceptional service. Yash and the team always go above and beyond to make sure customers are satisfied. Whether it's offering style advice or helping you find the perfect fit, they truly make shopping an enjoyable experience. If you're looking for high-quality fashion with personalized attention, this is the place to go!

featured_reviews.name: Vishal N Adnani
featured_reviews.review_text: Bought a shirt that's lasted over a year and the quality is still intact after over 30 washes. Highly recommend this place if you're looking for quality shirts in an economical price. Very friendly staff.

featured_reviews.name: Silver Jain
featured_reviews.review_text:
Premium fabric and definitely steal worthy. It looks sharp,feels goooood and the kind of shirt that mysteriously finds its way into my closet.So if you love your Dios shirt, you better keep an eye on it :))

It's a perfect chef's kiss!

featured_reviews.name: Rohit Birje Rane
featured_reviews.review_text:
Let's talk about Dios Damroos!
1. Service -  Great!
2. Quality - Great!
3. Pricing - Competitive

But what makes it stand out the most the the warm heartedness of the staff and the owners. They truly make you feel welcomed and would put even the most nervous of buyers at ease.
Yash who helps his family run the place is not only a great help but also very charming and entertaining. It's almost as if they should add service and entertainment taxes (but only after giving me that discount I was promised :p).

Would highly recommend you check it out and see what I mean for yourselves.

featured_reviews.name: Yash Punjabi
featured_reviews.review_text: I went to this store just to browse but I ended up buying so many clothes not only for me but also for my dad and grandad. They have a great selection of shirts, tshirts, pants, everything you name it. The staff is so friendly and so much fun. They gave me such a good price and a amazing discount. The quality of these clothes is just fabulous and so comfortable. You don’t go here just for shopping you go here for an experience and you will enjoy with the people who work here. They will help you select the perfect one at a very good price. Thank you so much for help me me and Don’t get influenced by the people who write bad reviews they are just jealous of you guys. Thanks again for helping me buy the perfect father’s day gift my grandad and dad are very happy. Will surely come and shop again and will tell all my friends and relatives to shop with you guys.
